title: Ford's Gym

services.name: Personal Training
services.desc: We have a number of trainers available at Ford’s Gym. Ford Sheridan is a 1st Class Personal Trainer certified by the National Federation of Professional Trainers and is a competitive bodybuilder and powerlifter. Sam Masino recently won the 2015 Best in Madison and is also a competitive bodybuilder and powerlifter. Whether it is losing weight, gaining weight or just firming up, we have the knowledge from our years of experience in the field. If you’ve been working out for years or just beginning, you can increase your results with an exercise program monitored by a personal trainer. We help beginners start off on the right foot by analyzing your current diet and teaching you how to train
